description: This file defines the DatabaseConnectionWrapper class which manages database connection states, error handling, and connection establishment, encapsulating functionality around the Doctrine DBAL library for a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing database connections, error detection, and providing error messages within the OrangeHRM installer, utilizing Doctrine DBAL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a Doctrine DBAL connection object and optional Throwable for error tracking.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if an error has occurred during the last connection attempt.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly error message based on the stored exception or error code.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the stored Throwable instance representing an error, if any.

methods.name: establishConnection
methods.description: Static method to attempt establishing a database connection using a provided callable, with pre-connection checks for PDO extension support.
